name: jira_sprints_list
description: Returns all sprints from a board, optionally filtered by state (GET /rest/agile/1.0/board/{boardId}/sprint)

board_id.description: The ID of the board that contains the requested sprints, for example 1.

state.description: Filters results to sprints in the specified states. Valid values: future, active, closed.

limit.description: The maximum number of sprints to return per page. Default: 30.
